name: Oracle
description: An ageless cosmic seer of perfect calm who sings drifting ambient new-age as though reading the song off the stars.
build: Very tall, slender and elongated, with a long neck, narrow sloping shoulders and long slow-moving arms; a tall column silhouette that widens only at the robe hem. Never muscular, broad or stooped.
face: A smooth oval face with pale lavender skin, high cheekbones, a small straight nose, a calm closed-lip half-smile, and large almond eyes that are solid pale gold with no visible pupils. A small glowing white dot sits centred on the brow.
hair: No hair: a smooth, bare, slightly elongated lavender crown.
outfit: A long flowing floor-length robe of pale silver-white with wide belled sleeves that fall past the fingertips; the lining of the sleeves and the open front panels is deep indigo scattered with tiny white star points, visible whenever the robe moves. A high stand-up collar frames the neck. A narrow gold cord ties at the waist. The hem pools at the feet so only bare lavender toes show.
personality: Serene, kind and unhurried; faintly amused by everything.
performance_style: Upright and still: feet together under the pooled robe, shoulders level, both hands raised to chest height with palms turned slightly upward and fingers softly spread, eyes half-lidded.
location: An observatory dome at night: a polished dark-violet floor of hexagonal tiles running to the bottom of the frame, a clean curved back wall of deep indigo panels, a huge round viewport in that wall showing a ringed planet and a spiral nebula, and a thin ring of soft lilac light around the floor's edge.
recognition_cues: pale lavender skin and a bare elongated crown
a silver-white robe with a star-field indigo lining
avoid: human-coloured skin or grey alien skin
black pupils or glowing red eyes
a staff, orb, crystal ball or floating objects
a sinister, sly or menacing expression
a short robe, visible legs or shoes
high kicks or wide stances that split the robe
any franchise alien or mystic design

animations.dance: Slow ambient sway loop: from the upright opening stance, shift weight gently onto the character-left foot while both arms float outward and up so the wide sleeves open and show the star-field lining, rotate the torso a few degrees, then drift weight across to the character-right foot as the arms trace a slow circle down, and return to the exact opening stance with hands at chest height. Feet stay under the robe; no kicks, jumps or quick steps.

sing.intent: Ambient sustained-note loop: tilt the head slightly back and lift the free character-left hand slowly outward as a long note unfurls, the sleeve falling open to show the stars, then draw it back to chest height. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop, from a soft round 'oo' to a wider open vowel, so she unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief room-sound reaction: the gold eyes widen, the head draws back an inch and the sleeves flutter as the hands lift, then she lets out a calm breath and resettles into her serene stance. No opponent or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: turn one shoulder forward and raise the free forearm so the wide sleeve drapes across the body like a curtain, then hold that calm, level stance. Not a combat pose.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: glide in with small unseen steps beneath the pooled robe, stop, let the sleeves settle, then raise both hands to chest height into her opening stance.
animations.victory: One-shot finish: spread both arms wide and high so the sleeves fall open to show the full star-field lining, tip the face upward with a serene smile, then bring the palms together at the chest and hold a tall still pose.
animations.ko: Non-contact performance defeat: she stays on her feet while her calm dims — the arms sink to hang at her sides with the sleeves covering the hands, the long neck bows so the head drops forward, and the gold eyes close. She holds a standing, visibly drained finish. She remains standing on both feet in every frame — no kneeling, crouching, sitting, sinking, or going to the ground. Do not imply a hit or opponent.
